ops_convention: mults/adds/nonlin per classification of one 128-sample window; a MAC = 1 mult + 1 add; ternary taps = 1 add per non-zero tap (no multiply)

models.label: DLNN
models.desc: Ternary delay-line net (TDL-Net-B w8, d=1, ternary readout) on an ideal line

models.label: DLNN-B
models.desc: Board-trained DLNN (TDL-Net-B w8, float readout), run on the simulated M1a board line: every tap sees the input through its measured line FIR (Q = 10 corner). Board-trained, on the simulated board line.

line_fir_provenance.contents: line + input RC only (ideal unity buffer after the RC); no TLV9062 macro, no noise, no crosstalk, no mismatch
line_fir_provenance.normalisation: common: mean on-lag gain over both corners and all taps = 1

meta.selection: validation: last 2000 train examples, macro acc (mean Q10/Q30) with min-class floor 0.35

models.label: DLNN-F
models.desc: Same DLNN as DLNN, but with a float digital readout (what the Nucleo would run), ideal line

models.label: Feature MLP
models.desc: Fair conventional competitor: MLP (3 hidden units, matched size) on 319 phase-invariant hand-built features (|z|, instantaneous frequency, |FFT| of z, z^2 and z^4)

models.label: Raw-I/Q MLP
models.desc: MLP on flattened raw I/Q (256 inputs), 4 hidden units

models.label: Reservoir
models.desc: Random ternary delay reservoir + ridge readout

models.label: Cumulant
models.desc: Classical higher-order cumulant features + logistic regression

models.label: MLP-L
models.desc: MLP on flattened I/Q, 32 hidden units
